basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Entrepreneurial AI Leader | 3 Companies Founded | Startup Advisor (Tenity) | MBA
basics.summary: Builder and advisor at the intersection of AI, business transformation, and measurable revenue. Owns LumApps' AI program end-to-end, reporting to C-level on outcomes: production agents forecast to generate $4M in approved opportunities per quarter. Shipped $1.5M+ in new product revenue and eliminated $337K in vendor cost at Beekeeper, co-owning GTM with Sales and PM. Founded three companies on the side; advise 20+ startups on AI and architecture as Tenity's Technology Evaluation Panelist. MBA, EPFL research background.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns company-wide AI transformation strategy, governance, and sales enablement. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes, bridging engineering, product, and revenue.
highlights: Owns AI transformation strategy and governance across the company. Translates AI capability into executive decisions; the kind of mandate a Principal Consultant would deliver, owned from inside.

Built and shipped production AI agents for outbound sales. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day. Forecast: $4M in approved opportunities per quarter; $1M quarterly revenue at 25% conversion.
Built AI Brain, a knowledge-graph context layer that surfaces business patterns driving strategy across product, sales, and CS. Turns AI investment into measurable, executive-readable insight.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who operates like a founding engineer. Owned the problem, designed the solution, shipped to prod, stayed accountable to the business metric across multiple revenue-bearing AI products.
highlights: Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end as Tech Lead of the Incubation team (reporting to CIO). Became the platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR. Built the team and ran GTM with Sales and PM.
Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated. Direct, measurable client value from AI investment.
Co-owned GTM launches across Product and Sales (Seasonal Templates, Re-ignite Revenue, Sentiment Analysis). Each shipped with instrumentation; killed what did not move the needle within a week.
Hired and mentored the AI engineering cohort; deputy tech lead of FUEL. Built engineering culture around shipping measurable business outcomes, not artefacts.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Member of the Technology Evaluation Panel for a leading Swiss accelerator. Advises seed-to-VC stage founders on AI strategy, technical architecture, and building engineering cultures that ship.
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on AI readiness, architecture, and scalability. Findings directly inform seed-to-VC investment decisions; the closest analog to senior advisory mandate work in my profile.
Advised portfolio companies on AI strategy, technical hiring, and engineering culture. Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems in production.

work.name: Obermatt
work.summary: Bridged business and engineering for a Zurich fintech. Owned product roadmap and led a remote engineering team while concurrently working as founding engineer at Dronistics.
highlights: Built strategic product roadmaps that improved customer satisfaction and retention. Translated business priorities into engineering execution; the consulting-to-delivery handover in microcosm.
Directed a remote engineering team. Introduced agile methodologies; productivity up 20%. Improved CI/CD with Docker; deployment times down 30%.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an EPFL spin-off building autonomous drone delivery. Built the technical credibility that opened doors with enterprise customers.
highlights: Architected end-to-end platform that enabled enterprise partnerships with Unilever and a CES Las Vegas showcase. Customer-facing technical credibility from the founder's seat.
500+ autonomous deliveries; 40% faster, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents. Production-grade reliability that customers and partners could trust.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: AI research at EPFL's Laboratory of Intelligent Systems. Built Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot morphologies and control systems via genetic algorithms.
highlights: Engineered Robogen at one of Europe's leading AI labs. Open-source platform for co-evolution of robot bodies and brains via genetic algorithms.
Migrated simulation pipeline to AWS; secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog. Real example of translating academic work into industry-visible outcomes.
Teaching Assistant for Evolutionary Robotics at EPFL. Supervised 20+ master's students. Early reps at translating technical depth into stakeholder understanding.

projects.name: SwissNRI - AI Cross-border Fintech
projects.description: Co-founded the first AI-native platform for Swiss-Indian families navigating FEMA, DTAA, and Swiss tax regulations. Built the business from market gap to live users in a regulated space.
highlights: Zero-to-MVP in 3 months. RAG-grounded tax assistant with citations to source regulation; AI agents flag DTAA/FEMA risks before users file. 40% uplift in satisfaction from feedback-driven iteration.

projects.name: Proplab - AI for Real Estate
projects.description: Founded an AI-native platform for small real estate teams. Vision models turn inspection photos into structured records; LLM agents turn those records into marketing-ready listings.
highlights: End-to-end agent workflow from photo capture to published listing. Identified market gap, built MVP, shipped to early customers solo.

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Founded an explainable AI market intelligence platform. Built for my own trading portfolio first, then opened to retail traders.
highlights: Live users, real money, end-to-end multi-agent system shipped solo while operating as principal engineer at LumApps. Demonstrates speed and accountability in parallel.
